op: zh-TW native conversion of a zh-CN tied embedding (v3: word rename/swap + char twin transfer + suppression/boost rebalance)
role: tied: embedding AND unembedding (no lm_head; C engine requires the tie)
formula: (1) words: for each Simplified token w with a Traditional spelling c -- if c is an existing token and cos(w,k)>=WORD_COS_MIN, swap the strings and serve c with w's row (k gets w's string, then suppression); if cos < WORD_COS_MIN, k's row keeps TWIN_STRENGTH of w's row; if c is free, rename w to c (needs corpus attestation of c and |E[w]| >= RENAME_NRM_MIN). (2) chars: a Traditional glyph row takes CHAR_TWIN of its Simplified twin's direction at cos >= CHAR_GATE, skipping glyphs the zh-TW corpus never uses. (3) softmax rebalance: ids emitting a Simplified-only glyph go to SUPPRESS_L of their row; ids emitting a genuinely Traditional glyph go to TRAD_BOOST.
mapping_source: Unihan kTraditionalVariant/kSimplifiedVariant (glyph sets) + kTotalScore; polysemy by cos over the model's own multi-char tokens; word/glyph attestation by an eval-disjoint zh-TW corpus
